data_fields.name: sealed_bless_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: 128 (bless value at or above this cannot be traded)

data_fields.name: trade_range
data_fields.donor_constant: none: no distance check after the window opens (facing only at answer time)

best_idea: Escrow by move: an offered stack leaves its owner's bag the moment it is offered, so it cannot be spent during the trade; a cancel of any kind, including a disconnect, returns it.
decision_why: Keeps escrow-by-move and the cancel-on-quit rule. Fixes the donor's gaps: any offer change clears both confirmations (the partner can change the deal after the other side confirms in the donor); range checked at confirm and cancel out of range (none in the donor); room reserved at offer and re-checked per receiver before any move (the donor checks current contents only, and the store never refuses); automatic bans replaced by log, cancel and review. Rejects the per-player side inventory as escrow store (one-ledger rule).
acceptance: Server test: A offers a sword and confirms; B adds 10 gold; A's confirm clears and A sees back-to-trade; the trade does not settle until A confirms again. While offered, the sword is absent from A's bag. Second test: the two players walk 15 tiles apart before the second confirm; the trade cancels and the sword returns to A's bag. Player sees the confirm tick drop on both windows when either side changes an offer.
